Interface SourceCompiler

All Superinterfaces:
AutoCloseable, Closeable
All Known Implementing Classes:
GroovySourceCompiler, JavacSourceCompiler, StagedSourceCompiler
public interface SourceCompiler extends Closeable
Compiles the sources of one or more languages into the class output directory, inside the development JVM.

Implementations are discovered through META-INF/services and asked whether they are available: the Kotlin and Groovy compilers are only when the project put the compiler on the launch classpath. A compiler keeps whatever warm state it can between requests (loaded processors, a compiler session) and releases it when closed.

    • compile

      CompilationResult compile(CompilationRequest request)
      Compiles the request.

      A failed compilation leaves the output directory as it was, so the running application keeps serving the previous generation. The result's diagnostics say what went wrong.

      Callers serialize compilations: a compiler may stage its output and back up what it replaces in fixed directories, so two calls of one compiler must not overlap. The launcher compiles on a single thread.

      Parameters:
      request - What to compile
      Returns:
      The result
